title: A localization map is regular
statement: Let $S$ be a commutative ring and $W\subset S$ a multiplicative subset, with localization map $S\to W^{-1}S$, $s\mapsto s/1$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then $S\to W^{-1}S$ is a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. (Its fibre ring over a prime $\mathfrak p\subset S$ is $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ if $\mathfrak p\cap W=\emptyset$ and $0$ otherwise.)
